name: aeon
description: Run and manage your Aeon autonomous agent from chat: skills, runs, memory, strategy, packs and settings. Aeon is an open-source autonomous agent that runs skills on a schedule with GitHub Actions in your own repo. This hosted MCP server lets you list and run skills, follow runs and read their output, search the agent's memory, edit its strategy and voice, install skill packs and change settings. Sign in with GitHub and choose which agent the client may use. Writes are annotated and commit to your own repo; secrets are never readable over MCP.
